netherlands: Speaking for the four co-penholders, the Netherlands described tools the Council could consider.
These included sanctions, where appropriate, against those who deny humanitarian access unlawfully or starve civilians.
united_states: The United States encouraged the Secretary-General to warn the Council proactively about conflict-related famine conditions.
The United States looked forward to more regular, continuous reporting in the context of country-specific situations.
russia: Russia argued that food insecurity also reflects factors outside armed conflict, including natural disasters and unilateral economic restrictions.
Russia said the broader food-security problem extended beyond the Security Council's scope.
sanctions: Paragraph 9 recalls that the Council has previously adopted and may consider sanctions, where appropriate and consistent with existing practice.
Paragraph 9 identifies individuals or entities obstructing the delivery of, access to, or distribution of humanitarian assistance.
reporting: Paragraph 11 asks the Secretary-General to continue regular country-specific reporting on the humanitarian situation and response, including famine and food-insecurity risk.
Paragraph 12 separately requests swift reporting to the Council when the relevant risk arises in armed conflict.
us-paraphrase: The United States favored the Secretary-General giving the Council advance warning of famine linked to conflict.
The United States wanted more consistent and frequent reports within its review of particular country situations.
reporting-paraphrase: In paragraph 11, the Council asks the Secretary-General to keep including the risk of hunger and famine in scheduled country reports.
In paragraph 12, it adds a request to tell the Council promptly when the risk of famine and widespread food insecurity arises in armed conflict.
sanctions-paraphrase: Paragraph 9 points to prior sanctions and leaves the Council free to consider them where appropriate under established practice.
The possible measures concern those who interfere with humanitarian relief being delivered, accessed or distributed.
nl-paraphrase: On behalf of the four drafters, the Netherlands discussed measures the Council might consider.

sanctions-imposed-fiction: Paragraph 9 imposes new sanctions on all parties denying humanitarian access.
